title: Destroyer of Rāvaṇa's Pride
translation: Worshipped by the best of gods and sages, the one that burned Kāma, the mine of compassion, the liṅga that destroyed Rāvaṇa's pride: I bow to that liṅga of Sadāśiva.
translation_hi: जो देवताओं और श्रेष्ठ मुनियों द्वारा पूजित है, कामदेव को भस्म करने वाला, करुणा का भंडार है, और जिसने रावण का अहंकार नष्ट किया, उस सदाशिव लिंग को मैं प्रणाम करता हूँ।

words.note: The author of the Tāṇḍava stotra!

grammar: A link between hymns: Rāvaṇa, who sang the Tāṇḍava stotra, once tried to lift Kailāsa; Shiva pressed it down with his toe and humbled his pride.
Ākara 'mine, source': करुणाकर. Compare रत्नाकर (the ocean, 'mine of jewels').
Refrain: तत्प्रणमामि सदाशिवलिङ्गम् 'I bow to that liṅga of Sadāśiva.'
